Run.iter_inner_content() returns empty list when run contains text elements

#### Description

When iterating over inner content items in a run that contains text elements, the method returns an empty list instead of the expected content items.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document
from docx.text.run import Run

# Create a document with a run containing text and other elements
doc = Document()
paragraph = doc.add_paragraph()
run = paragraph.add_run("foo")

# Try to iterate over inner content
inner_content = list(run.iter_inner_content())
print(f"Inner content items: {len(inner_content)}")
print(f"Content types: {[type(item).__name__ for item in inner_content]}")

# Expected: Should return content items including text
# Actual: Returns empty list
```

The issue occurs specifically when runs contain text elements mixed with other content like line breaks or page breaks. The method should return the text content as string items along with other elements, but instead returns nothing.
</issue>
